metaTitle: {brand} — a catalogue of Counter-Strike 2 skins, knives and gloves
metaDescription: Buy Counter-Strike 2 weapon skins, knives and gloves from {brand}. Every lot carries its condition, classification and price, and is delivered to your Steam account by {method} once payment is confirmed.

hero.title: Counter-Strike 2 skins, hung and ready for your inventory
hero.lead: Finishes, knives and gloves for {game}. One item to a listing, one condition to an item, with its condition and float range printed well before you pay.

featured.title: Covert, knives and gloves
featured.lead: The top classifications on the wall, a single lot from each weapon.

delivery.title: How delivery works
delivery.lead: There is no parcel. Each item arrives as a {method} from a delivery account.

account.title: Sign in with Steam
account.body: Connect whichever Steam account the lots should land in. All we read is the Steam ID and profile name your profile already publishes.

tradeUrl.title: Save your trade URL
tradeUrl.body: Copy the trade URL out of your Steam inventory settings and paste it here. We verify it against the account you connected.

pay.title: Settle on the secure page
pay.body: The card itself is handled on our provider's page. Prices get one final check before anything is charged.

accept.title: Accept the trade offer
accept.body: We send the offer {usual}. Take it in Steam before it lapses. Steam can hold or protect received items for up to {protection} days; without the Mobile Authenticator a hold can last up to {hold} days.
